text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Well then, could the two of you prepare 
the documents? Sorry, but please have them 
done by today...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. With this amount, it should 
be finished—before training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Symboli Kris S took on an urgent 
job together with her classmate, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Are you alright? You should go—to the 
infirmary.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Just me—is enough. So—don't 
hold back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Symboli Kris S prepared 
flawless materials all on her own. 
However, she didn't make it in time for 
training...
